answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price admission with stake that decays unless renewed. Each juniper-seeded identity bonds capital to join; a meadow of cheap bots is uneconomic when every seat posts real collateral. Attestation committees rotate comet-fast, so one operator spawning thousands of clones pays the bond per clone and loses them all when any clone cheats. The attacker pays the full bond times the sybil count, and the bond burns on detection, so volume attacks bankrupt themselves.
